name: World Bank — Indicators API v2 (World Development Indicators)

rate_limit.source: No fixed limit; the terms forbid use that 'exceeds reasonable request volume or constitutes excessive or abusive usage' (terms of use, read 2026-10-23). Self-imposed: one request per second, one request per indicator for all countries.

failure_behavior: 429/5xx: bounded backoff, then the run fails; stored values keep their availability times. A null value is stored as NOT_YET_PUBLISHED, never zero.

datasets.description: Annual GDP growth (NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG), CPI inflation (FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG) and unemployment, ILO modelled estimate (SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS), percent, decimal text as published
datasets.coverage: US, IN and the EU countries of config/markets/venues.json
datasets.update_frequency: WDI updates several times a year (lastupdated is recorded)
datasets.availability_rule: No vintages: available from first-seen receipt time (flag available_from_first_capture); a changed value on re-fetch is a new publication at its receipt time flagged revised_after_first_seen. History is therefore not usable for backtests before the capture date.
datasets.rights_source: Data catalog public licences: CC BY 4.0 is the default licence for datasets produced by the World Bank (credit the World Bank, note modifications). Terms of use: APIs for non-commercial use, no charging for access or redistribution, reasonable volume. Verdict: allowed for single-owner research with attribution 'Source: World Bank, World Development Indicators'; cloud-model processing withheld until the owner decides.
